title: What our customers say
intro: Reviews collected in store and from delivery follow-ups.

items.name: Lakshmi Reddy
items.text: The monthly list feature saved me two trips. I pick the family size, print it, and everything is on one page in aisle order.

items.name: Suresh Kumar
items.text: Produce is genuinely fresh — the bananas and greens are clearly same-day, not sitting in a cold room for a week.

items.name: Anita Sharma
items.text: Ordered at four, it arrived by seven the same evening. Everything was packed properly and nothing was substituted without asking.

items.name: Mohammed Irfan
items.text: Bulk staples are cheaper here than the big chains, and they will break a 5 kg bag if you only need two.

items.name: Priya Venkatesh
items.text: The baby care bundle is a real saving, and the staff actually know which cereal suits which age.

items.name: Rajesh Naidu
items.text: Good range for a neighbourhood store. If something is out of stock they tell you when it is due rather than guessing.
